question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Nvidia guided Q3 FY27 revenue to $108.0B ±2% (no China DC). Over the last 8 quarters it beat its guidance midpoint by +2.5% to +7.9% (median ~+4.9%; Q2 FY27: $91.0B guide → $96.2B; Q1: ~$78B → $81.6B). Median beat implies ~$113.3B. Consensus rose to ~$111.3B by mid-Oct. The October selloff and CoreWeave worries matter little to revenue for a quarter ending late Oct; downside comes from supply limits or a product-transition dip. Going past $116B needs a beat of about 7.4% or more (1 of 8 quarters). Thin Manifold market (4 traders) centers ~$112B, slightly below me.

- Q2 FY27 (ended late Jul 2026): revenue $96.2B, +106% y/y, +18% q/q; data center $89.0B; gross margin 75.0% (Nvidia 8-K, Aug 26 2026).
- Q2 FY27 guidance was $91.0B ±2% (Nvidia Q1 FY27 8-K, May 2026); actual came in +5.7% above the midpoint. Bloomberg consensus was ~$92.5B.
- Q3 FY27 guidance: $108.0B ±2% ($105.8B–$110.2B), assuming no China data-center compute revenue (Nvidia 8-K, Aug 2026).
- Actual vs guidance midpoint, by quarter: Q3FY25 35.1 vs 32.5 (+7.9%); Q4FY25 39.3 vs 37.5 (+4.9%); Q1FY26 44.1 vs 43.0 (+2.5%, the quarter with the China H20 charge); Q2FY26 46.7 vs 45.0 (+3.9%); Q3FY26 57.0 vs 54.0 (+5.6%); Q4FY26 68.1 vs 65.0 (+4.8%); Q1FY27 81.6 vs ~78 (+4.6%); Q2FY27 96.2 vs 91.0 (+5.7%). Guidance points before FY27 are from background knowledge. No miss against the guidance midpoint in this window.
- Sell-side consensus for Q3 FY27: ~$103.5B (late Aug, 4 estimates) rising to ~$111.3B (MarketBeat, Oct 2026); estimate revised up ~5.7% over 3 months (chartmill).
- Oct 2026 macro: hot CPI (3.7% y/y), 10-year Treasury yield at its highest since 2002, AI/semis lost ~$1T in one week (mid-Oct); worries about CoreWeave (Nvidia holds ~11%); Huang says no backstop is needed (Fresno Bee/TheStreet, Oct 19 2026).
- Motley Fool (Sep 15 2026) argues the $108B guide is conservative.
- Report date: question expects ~Nov 25 2026; MarketBeat lists ~Nov 17. The fiscal quarter ends ~late Oct 2026.
- Status quo: Nvidia reports above the top of its ±2% guidance band (every quarter in the window above except Q1 FY26 at +2.5%).
- Resolves off total revenue in the Q3 FY27 earnings release / 8-K, not data-center revenue or later restatements.
- Event window: quarter ending ~Oct 25 2026; report expected ~Nov 17–25 2026; as of Oct 20 the quarter is ~95% elapsed, so revenue is mostly already booked.
- Upside break: a beat of about 7.4% or more puts revenue above $116B (1 of 8 quarters beat by that much). Downside: supply limits (HBM/CoWoS), Rubin transition timing, customers pausing on financing stress.
- Searched for but not found: Q3 preannouncement, any China license approval, supply-chain cuts tied to Q3.

calls.reconciliation: The three runs agree on the core facts (guide of $108B ±2%, Q2 actual $96.2B vs $91B guide, history of 2.5–7.9% beats, consensus ~$111.3B), so they converge on a median of $113.0–113.4B. The factual disputes don't affect the outcome: the report date (Nov 17/18/25) changes nothing because resolution keys off the quarter, and the guidance points before FY27 come from memory and can't be verified, though dropping the +7.9% Q3 FY25 point only narrows the beat range slightly. The remaining dispute is judgment about tail width. I kept dispersion near the SD of past beats (~$4.1B) and put 7% on >$116B because beat sizes have recently been rising and the 1-in-8 frequency supports it. Downside below $105B is not separately priced. No markets worth anchoring on: Run 2 found no total-revenue market on Polymarket or Kalshi, a thin Manifold market (4 traders) centres on $110–112B, and a Polymarket data-center revenue market has about $2K of volume with incoherent prices — I used these as weak evidence only.
